entities.summary: Nikolay Nikolayevich Muravyov-Karsky was an Imperial Russian military officer, a general of the Russian Army and a writer. A member of the mighty Muravyov family. He became famous for the capture of Kars in the Crimean War, for which he was unofficially nicknamed Karsky.
